snacks.text: Good. PG food finishes by nine, then hunger comes at eleven. Keep this.

water.text: Cold one is ₹22. Okay, okay — ₹20 for you.

start_act1.text: Biscuits, chips, Maggi — or something bigger? Office people buy table-chair from me. Folding. Eighteen hundred, delivery free.

delivery.text: (Twenty minutes later, a boy with the flat-pack at Shanthamma's gate.) Where to keep, saar? … Three cots, one almirah, one table already. (He looks at the floor. The floor looks back.) Not enough space. I'll keep it in the godown till you have a room, no charge.

stored.text: Table-chair is safe in the godown. Find a room with a floor, I'll send it the same day.
